issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the phrase 'εμε την πτερναν αυτου' (his heel against me), which is a crucial part of the quoted scripture. The Vietnamese only includes 'giơ gót chân lên nghịch cùng ta' (lifted his heel up against me), missing the specific 'against me' prepositional relationship/object structure as it relates to the Greek 'εμε'.
